scenes.voiceover: You've got something to say about your city. Your vote. Your future.
But you've seen what happens. Strangers. Trolls. Your boss. Your aunt. So you say nothing. And nothing changes.
Say what you actually think. No followers. No pile-on. Post it, and walk away.
Your voice. Your city. Zero drama. Choseno.
